name: Action Network
description: Action Network is a progressive organizing platform for activists, petitions, events, forms, fundraising, advocacy, surveys, targeting, email and supporter data.
agentUseSummary: Add a partner-enabled API key for one exact personal or group list, then let selected agents use all 104 pinned current v2 operations. API metadata reads run directly; all account-data reads and every mutation require approval in Safe mode.

credentialRequirements.name: ACTION_NETWORK_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Action Network API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate a dedicated key for the exact personal or group list after Action Network enables the partner API feature. Relay encrypts it and sends it only to actionnetwork.org as OSDI-API-Token.

capabilities.description: Use all 40 documented v2 mutations, including real message schedule/send controls, under Safe approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All 104 pinned operations run without Relay per-action approval; account-key scope, fixed routes, activist privacy, payload bounds, audits and provider limits still apply.

providerSetup.blocker: Action Network must enable partner API access and an authorized administrator must generate a dedicated key for the exact personal or group list. Live acceptance needs representative activist/action data and explicit authorization to test sensitive political records and mass-email controls in Railway staging.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized administrator obtains partner access, generates a least-privilege list-specific key, stores it through Relay Console, then validates health, account binding, one approved read per resource family, each mutation family, four-call-per-second behavior, message schedule/send/stop safeguards, rotation, disconnect and post-disconnect denial in Railway staging.

evidence.supports: The current official v2 HAL+JSON API documents partner API keys, the fixed API entry point, OSDI-API-Token authentication, exact resource/helper surface, paging/filtering, and the prohibition on building a replacement user interface.
The official getting-started guide records July 2026 v2 updates and limits clients to four calls per second.
The send helper can send a targeted mass email immediately and stop it mid-send, requiring critical risk and Safe approval.
The current privacy notice covers names, addresses, email addresses, telephone numbers and other identifiable supporter information.
The terms govern progressive organizing, email and mobile messaging services, data security, acceptable use and customer responsibility.
